# ely-editor

Source: ELY-Open-Source/Ely-GPUI-Components, commit e0f355ac1a669c24336244bcaa8131f7f0e4f1b5, crates/ely-editor.

The manifest expands upstream workspace dependencies. LICENSE is the upstream MIT license.

Local changes: opt-in source wrapping on viewport and font-size changes, with source offsets, selections, mouse input, IME placement, vertical navigation and undo preserved. Wrapped rows share line highlighting within each frame.
